title: 网络安全 · 应用安全与 DevSecOps 30 句
description: 覆盖威胁建模、安全需求、代码审查、依赖治理、流水线、API 与上线风险的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 威胁建模应在架构仍可调整时进行，而不是等到代码已经完成。
items.en: Threat modelling should take place while the architecture can still be changed, rather than after the code has been completed.
answers: Threat modelling should take place while the architecture can still be changed, rather than after the code has been completed.
items.notes: while 表示仍可调整的阶段；rather than after 对比介入时机。

items.zh: 团队首先识别信任边界，因为数据跨越边界时通常需要额外验证。
items.en: The team identifies trust boundaries first because data usually requires additional validation when it crosses them.
answers: The team identifies trust boundaries first because data usually requires additional validation when it crosses them.
items.notes: because 解释建模顺序；when 引出跨边界情境。

items.zh: 滥用场景描述攻击者如何误用功能，从而补充正常用户故事没有覆盖的行为。
items.en: Abuse cases describe how an attacker might misuse a function, thereby covering behaviour omitted from normal user stories.
answers: Abuse cases describe how an attacker might misuse a function, thereby covering behaviour omitted from normal user stories.
items.notes: how 引导描述内容；thereby doing 说明补充作用。

items.zh: 如果系统接受来自合作伙伴的数据，就不能仅因网络连接受信任而跳过输入校验。
items.en: If the system accepts data from a partner, it should not skip input validation merely because the network connection is trusted.
answers: If the system accepts data from a partner, it should not skip input validation merely because the network connection is trusted.
items.notes: if 引出数据场景；merely because 批评不充分理由。

items.zh: 评审发现最严重的风险来自组件之间的交互，而不是任何单个组件。
items.en: The review found that the most serious risk arose from the interaction between components rather than from any component in isolation.
answers: The review found that the most serious risk arose from the interaction between components rather than from any component in isolation.
items.notes: arise from 表示源于；rather than from 构成来源对比。

items.zh: 安全需求规定敏感操作必须重新认证，却没有限定具体界面实现。
items.en: The security requirement mandates re-authentication for sensitive actions without prescribing a particular interface design.
answers: The security requirement mandates re-authentication for sensitive actions without prescribing a particular interface design.
items.notes: mandate 表示强制要求；without prescribing 保留实现自由。

items.zh: 验收标准应说明未经授权的请求会被拒绝，并留下可供调查的日志。
items.en: The acceptance criteria should require unauthorised requests to be rejected and logged in a form suitable for investigation.
answers: The acceptance criteria should require unauthorised requests to be rejected and logged in a form suitable for investigation.
items.notes: require A to be done；in a form suitable for 限定日志可用性。

items.zh: 把安全任务放入产品待办列表后，才能与功能需求一起确定优先级。
items.en: Security work can be prioritised alongside functional requirements only after it has been placed in the product backlog.
answers: Security work can be prioritised alongside functional requirements only after it has been placed in the product backlog.
items.notes: only after 强调纳入待办的前提；alongside 表示一同。

items.zh: 开发团队接受了当前风险，但例外将在身份模块重构完成后到期。
items.en: The development team accepted the current risk, but the exception will expire when the identity module is refactored.
answers: The development team accepted the current risk, but the exception will expire when the identity module is refactored.
items.notes: but 连接临时接受与到期条件；when 引出生命周期事件。

items.zh: 没有明确资产价值时，团队很难在安全缺陷与交付压力之间作出一致取舍。
items.en: Without a clear view of asset value, the team cannot make consistent trade-offs between security defects and delivery pressure.
answers: Without a clear view of asset value, the team cannot make consistent trade-offs between security defects and delivery pressure.
items.notes: without 引出决策信息缺口；trade-offs between 是常用搭配。

items.zh: 代码审查关注授权逻辑是否在每个入口执行，而不只是公共接口。
items.en: The code review checks whether authorisation logic is enforced at every entry point, not just at the public interface.
answers: The code review checks whether authorisation logic is enforced at every entry point, not just at the public interface.
items.notes: whether 引导审查内容；not just 限定覆盖范围。

items.zh: 参数化查询阻止输入改变语句结构，从而降低注入风险。
items.en: A parameterised query prevents input from altering the structure of the statement, thereby reducing injection risk.
answers: A parameterised query prevents input from altering the structure of the statement, thereby reducing injection risk.
items.notes: prevent A from doing；thereby doing 说明安全结果。

items.zh: 输出编码必须与使用数据的上下文匹配，因为 HTML 和脚本上下文需要不同处理。
items.en: Output encoding must match the context in which the data is used, because HTML and script contexts require different treatment.
answers: Output encoding must match the context in which the data is used, because HTML and script contexts require different treatment.
items.notes: in which 引导定语从句；because 解释上下文相关性。

items.zh: 服务器不能依赖客户端隐藏按钮来实施权限，因为请求仍可被直接构造。
items.en: The server cannot rely on a hidden client-side button to enforce permission, since the request can still be constructed directly.
answers: The server cannot rely on a hidden client-side button to enforce permission, since the request can still be constructed directly.
items.notes: rely on A to do；since 解释客户端控制不足。

items.zh: 错误处理既要给用户足够信息完成操作，又不能暴露内部实现细节。
items.en: Error handling must give users enough information to proceed without disclosing internal implementation details.
answers: Error handling must give users enough information to proceed without disclosing internal implementation details.
items.notes: enough ... to do 表示足够信息；without doing 表示安全限制。

items.zh: 依赖扫描发现的是已知漏洞，因此没有告警不代表第三方代码没有缺陷。
items.en: Dependency scanning identifies known vulnerabilities, so the absence of an alert does not mean that third-party code is defect-free.
answers: Dependency scanning identifies known vulnerabilities, so the absence of an alert does not mean that third-party code is defect-free.
items.notes: does not mean that 限制扫描结论；defect-free 表示没有缺陷。

items.zh: 锁定依赖版本提高构建可重复性，但团队仍需计划如何接收安全更新。
items.en: Pinning dependency versions makes builds reproducible, but the team still needs a process for receiving security updates.
answers: Pinning dependency versions makes builds reproducible, but the team still needs a process for receiving security updates.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；make A B 是宾补结构。

items.zh: 软件物料清单记录发布包包含什么，从而在新漏洞披露时加快影响判断。
items.en: A software bill of materials records what a release contains, enabling faster impact assessment when a new vulnerability is disclosed.
answers: A software bill of materials records what a release contains, enabling faster impact assessment when a new vulnerability is disclosed.
items.notes: what 引导宾语从句；enabling 表示带来的能力。

items.zh: 如果维护者停止支持关键组件，当前没有漏洞也不能消除未来风险。
items.en: If a critical component is no longer maintained, the absence of a current vulnerability does not remove the future risk.
answers: If a critical component is no longer maintained, the absence of a current vulnerability does not remove the future risk.
items.notes: if 引出维护状态；does not remove 反驳只看当前漏洞的判断。

items.zh: 升级库时应测试行为变化，而不只是确认应用能够成功编译。
items.en: When a library is upgraded, behavioural changes should be tested rather than merely confirming that the application compiles.
answers: When a library is upgraded, behavioural changes should be tested rather than merely confirming that the application compiles.
items.notes: rather than merely doing 对比深度测试与表面检查。

items.zh: 构建流水线使用短期凭据，因此单次任务结束后权限会自动失效。
items.en: The build pipeline uses short-lived credentials so that access expires automatically after each job.
answers: The build pipeline uses short-lived credentials so that access expires automatically after each job.
items.notes: so that 说明设计结果；short-lived credentials 是流水线安全术语。

items.zh: 只有经过审查的制品才能从测试仓库提升到生产仓库。
items.en: Only artefacts that have passed review can be promoted from the test repository to the production repository.
answers: Only artefacts that have passed review can be promoted from the test repository to the production repository.
items.notes: only 限定提升条件；promote from ... to 表示制品晋级。

items.zh: 秘密扫描在提交进入主分支前拦截了凭据，但该凭据仍需要立即撤销。
items.en: Secret scanning blocked the credential before the commit reached the main branch, but the credential still had to be revoked immediately.
answers: Secret scanning blocked the credential before the commit reached the main branch, but the credential still had to be revoked immediately.
items.notes: before 引出拦截时机；but 强调拦截不等于消除泄露。

items.zh: 安全检查失败时默认阻止发布，例外则需要风险负责人批准并记录期限。
items.en: A failed security check blocks release by default, while an exception requires approval from the risk owner and a recorded expiry date.
answers: A failed security check blocks release by default, while an exception requires approval from the risk owner and a recorded expiry date.
items.notes: by default 表示默认行为；while 对比正常规则与例外流程。

items.zh: 流水线日志应保留足够的审计信息，同时遮盖令牌和连接字符串。
items.en: Pipeline logs should retain sufficient audit information while masking tokens and connection strings.
answers: Pipeline logs should retain sufficient audit information while masking tokens and connection strings.
items.notes: while doing 表示同时满足审计和保密要求；mask 表示遮盖。

items.zh: 接口只返回调用者有权查看的字段，即使后端对象包含更多数据。
items.en: The interface returns only fields the caller is authorised to view, even if the underlying object contains additional data.
answers: The interface returns only fields the caller is authorised to view, even if the underlying object contains additional data.
items.notes: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 fields；even if 引导让步。

items.zh: 速率限制降低自动化滥用的规模，却不能代替对每个请求的权限检查。
items.en: Rate limiting reduces the scale of automated abuse, but it cannot replace an authorisation check on each request.
answers: Rate limiting reduces the scale of automated abuse, but it cannot replace an authorisation check on each request.
items.notes: but 区分流量控制与授权控制；replace 表示不能替代。

items.zh: 客户端提供的对象标识符必须绑定到当前用户，不能仅检查它是否存在。
items.en: An object identifier supplied by the client must be bound to the current user, rather than checked only for existence.
answers: An object identifier supplied by the client must be bound to the current user, rather than checked only for existence.
items.notes: supplied 作后置定语；rather than 对比授权与存在性检查。

items.zh: 移动应用中的证书固定增加了拦截难度，但也需要安全的证书轮换方案。
items.en: Certificate pinning in the mobile application makes interception harder, although it also requires a safe certificate-rotation strategy.
answers: Certificate pinning in the mobile application makes interception harder, although it also requires a safe certificate-rotation strategy.
items.notes: make A B 是宾补；although 引出安全措施的运维代价。

items.zh: 上线决定应说明尚未修复的风险、补偿控制以及下一次复核日期。
items.en: The release decision should document unresolved risks, compensating controls, and the date of the next review.
answers: The release decision should document unresolved risks, compensating controls, and the date of the next review.
items.notes: 三个并列宾语使带风险上线可追踪；unresolved 表示尚未解决。
